attributes.description: Uploads, downloads, and deletions from Backblaze B2 access logs.

query.esql: FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD") | STATS `Files uploaded` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD") | STATS `Files uploaded` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_PART", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.PUT.PART", "REST.S3_UPLOAD_PART") | STATS `Data uploaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.access.object_size) / 1000000000.0

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_PART", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.PUT.PART", "REST.S3_UPLOAD_PART") | STATS `Data uploaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.access.object_size) / 1000000000.0

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY" | STATS Downloads = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY" | STATS Downloads = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND (event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*") | STATS Deletions = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND (event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*") | STATS Deletions = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.outcome == "failure" | STATS `Failed requests` = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.outcome == "failure" | STATS `Failed requests` = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" | STATS `Application keys used` = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.id)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" | STATS `Application keys used` = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.id)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL Activity = CASE(event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD"), "Upload", event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_COPY_FILE", "REST.S3_COPY_OBJECT"), "Server-side copy", http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY", "Download", event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*", "Delete", "Other") | WHERE Activity != "Other" | STATS Events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), Activity

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL Activity = CASE(event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD"), "Upload", event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_COPY_FILE", "REST.S3_COPY_OBJECT"), "Server-side copy", http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY", "Download", event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*", "Delete", "Other") | WHERE Activity != "Other" | STATS Events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), Activity

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" | EVAL Activity = CASE(event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD"), "Upload", event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_COPY_FILE", "REST.S3_COPY_OBJECT"), "Server-side copy", http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY", "Download", event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*", "Delete", "Other") | WHERE Activity != "Other" | STATS Events = COUNT(*) BY Bucket = backblaze_b2.access.bucket, Activity | SORT Events DESC | LIMIT 40

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" | EVAL Activity = CASE(event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD"), "Upload", event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_COPY_FILE", "REST.S3_COPY_OBJECT"), "Server-side copy", http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY", "Download", event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*", "Delete", "Other") | WHERE Activity != "Other" | STATS Events = COUNT(*) BY Bucket = backblaze_b2.access.bucket, Activity | SORT Events DESC | LIMIT 40

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND (event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD", "B2_API.B2_COPY_FILE", "REST.S3_COPY_OBJECT") OR event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*") | EVAL Hour = DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp), dow = DATE_EXTRACT("day_of_week", @timestamp), Day = CASE(dow == 1, "1 Mon", dow == 2, "2 Tue", dow == 3, "3 Wed", dow == 4, "4 Thu", dow == 5, "5 Fri", dow == 6, "6 Sat", "7 Sun") | STATS Events = COUNT(*) BY Hour, Day | SORT Day, Hour

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND (event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD", "B2_API.B2_COPY_FILE", "REST.S3_COPY_OBJECT") OR event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*") | EVAL Hour = DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp), dow = DATE_EXTRACT("day_of_week", @timestamp), Day = CASE(dow == 1, "1 Mon", dow == 2, "2 Tue", dow == 3, "3 Wed", dow == 4, "4 Thu", dow == 5, "5 Fri", dow == 6, "6 Sat", "7 Sun") | STATS Events = COUNT(*) BY Hour, Day | SORT Day, Hour

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" | EVAL Activity = CASE(event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD"), "Upload", http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY", "Download", event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*", "Delete", "Other") | STATS Requests = COUNT(*), Uploads = COUNT(CASE(Activity == "Upload", 1, null)), Downloads = COUNT(CASE(Activity == "Download", 1, null)), Deletions = COUNT(CASE(Activity == "Delete", 1, null)), Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(backblaze_b2.access.bucket), `Client IPs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip) BY `Requester type` = backblaze_b2.access.requester_type, `Key ID` = user.id | SORT Requests DESC | LIMIT 50

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" | EVAL Activity = CASE(event.action IN ("B2_API.B2_UPLOAD_FILE", "B2_API.B2_FINISH_LARGE_FILE", "REST.PUT.OBJECT", "REST.S3_PUT_OBJECT", "REST.S3_COMPLETE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD"), "Upload", http.request.method == "GET" AND (event.action LIKE "*DOWNLOAD*" OR event.action IN ("REST.GET.OBJECT", "REST.S3_GET_OBJECT")) AND event.action NOT LIKE "*.COPY", "Download", event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*", "Delete", "Other") | STATS Requests = COUNT(*), Uploads = COUNT(CASE(Activity == "Upload", 1, null)), Downloads = COUNT(CASE(Activity == "Download", 1, null)), Deletions = COUNT(CASE(Activity == "Delete", 1, null)), Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(backblaze_b2.access.bucket), `Client IPs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip) BY `Requester type` = backblaze_b2.access.requester_type, `Key ID` = user.id | SORT Requests DESC | LIMIT 50

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND source.ip IS NOT NULL | STATS Requests = COUNT(*), Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(backblaze_b2.access.bucket) BY `Client IP` = source.ip, Network = source.as.organization.name, Country = source.geo.country_iso_code, Client = user_agent.name | SORT Requests DESC | LIMIT 50

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND source.ip IS NOT NULL | STATS Requests = COUNT(*), Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(backblaze_b2.access.bucket) BY `Client IP` = source.ip, Network = source.as.organization.name, Country = source.geo.country_iso_code, Client = user_agent.name | SORT Requests DESC | LIMIT 50

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND (event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*") | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 100 | EVAL Time = @timestamp | KEEP Time, backblaze_b2.access.bucket, backblaze_b2.access.key, event.action, backblaze_b2.access.requester_type, user.id, backblaze_b2.access.object_size | RENAME backblaze_b2.access.bucket AS Bucket, backblaze_b2.access.key AS File, event.action AS Operation, backblaze_b2.access.requester_type AS Requester, user.id AS `Key ID`, backblaze_b2.access.object_size AS Size

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND (event.action LIKE "*DELETE*" OR event.action LIKE "*HIDE*") | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 100 | EVAL Time = @timestamp | KEEP Time, backblaze_b2.access.bucket, backblaze_b2.access.key, event.action, backblaze_b2.access.requester_type, user.id, backblaze_b2.access.object_size | RENAME backblaze_b2.access.bucket AS Bucket, backblaze_b2.access.key AS File, event.action AS Operation, backblaze_b2.access.requester_type AS Requester, user.id AS `Key ID`, backblaze_b2.access.object_size AS Size

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.outcome == "failure" | STATS Requests = COUNT(*) BY Operation = event.action, Status = http.response.status_code, `Error code` = error.code, Bucket = backblaze_b2.access.bucket | SORT Requests DESC | LIMIT 50

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.access-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.access" AND event.outcome == "failure" | STATS Requests = COUNT(*) BY Operation = event.action, Status = http.response.status_code, `Error code` = error.code, Bucket = backblaze_b2.access.bucket | SORT Requests DESC | LIMIT 50
